subject: Re: Loxley AI / Redwood - follow-up + demo slot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-09T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Loxley AI / Redwood - post-call recap + proposed tech deep-dive slots

Hi Sophie / Tom —

Great to meet today — thanks for walking through your primary latency pain points and the batch-inference use case. Quick recap from our side and clear next steps so we stay aligned: 

- What we heard: production tail latency for your realtime scoring pipeline spikes at 99th percentile during peak traffic and the current cache strategy is adding complexity when you scale to multi-region.
- Why Redwood helps: our serving runtime can prefix-cache KV layers and provide a predictable per-token cost profile across hosted and private deployments; we can run a short benchmark on a representative request shape during the technical deep-dive.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (2 slides on benchmarks + sequence-length impact), soc2-summary.pdf (answers to items you asked about around audit logs).

Next step: technical deep-dive with an infra engineer + product PM (30m). Two firm options below — please pick one that works for you or propose an immediate alternative: 

1) Tue May 10 — 10:00–10:30 AM PDT
2) Thu May 11 — 11:00–11:30 AM PDT

If you can confirm in the next 48 hours, I’ll send a calendar invite with the short agenda and a link to a shared dataset we can use for the quick perf test. If neither work, tell us two windows that do and we’ll do our best to match.

Thanks,
Ben
--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
